description: 대구광역시 동구_가스판매업소 현황 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대구광역시 동구. 가스판매업소 현황 조회서비스 API는 지역 내 가스를 취급하는 판매업소의 정보를 체계적으로 제공하는 데이터 서비스입니다. Coverage: 대구광역시 동구. The portal files it under the publisher 대구광역시 동구. Its tags are 가스판매업, 액화가스, 고압가스, 업소현황, 취급가스. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-08-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
